text:
lara-partnerships: Quick sync 90min: OrbitCloud confirmed listing in their new orbit-1 satellite region. Need marketplace entitlements, quota approval, KMS region plan, and SI integration window. Targeting soft launch next Tue. Who's on point?

mike-ops: @lara-partnerships can you share SKU/initial quotas? Ill open quota ticket with OrbitCloud once we have numbers. Also, who will upload marketplace assets?

lara-partnerships: I have assets ready (logos, short copy). Quota ask (provisional): 8 A100-80GB-equivalent GPUs + 40 vCPU control plane now, scale to 32 GPUs month 1 if traffic ramps. Sam, confirm.

sam-engineering: For initial wave expecting ~120 QPS peak, avg seq 256. Recommended: 10x 80GB GPUs (quantized) for serving + 4 control-plane VMs (8 vCPU each). If OrbitCloud offers only Turing family we need perf tests; fallback routing required.

anya-legal: NDA signed. OrbitCloud requires a DPA addendum and a short security questionnaire for marketplace. I can draft the DPA addendum today. Does security have canned answers?

jess-sales: Channel-sales wants a joint announcement but we should avoid public PR until quotas + DPA done. Could we do a private partner blog first? :eyes:

kevin-kms: Orbit-1 supports BYOK via their gateway but HSM-backed keys are delayed (~3 weeks). Can provision software keys now; HSM migration later. I will open tenant keyspace ticket if you want.

terry-cloud-sys: For OrbitCloud partner portal, paste this JSON into quota request form: ```json {"project":"redwood-orbit-1","quotas":[{"sku":"orbit.gpu.a100x80","limit":8},{"sku":"orbit.vcpu.standard","limit":40}],"requested_by":"mike-ops","eta":"2026-04-05"} ``` I'll triage once it's submitted.

deploy-bot: Runbook: https://docs.redwood.inference/internal/regions/orbit-1-onboard. Automated smoke deploy queued: `deploy --region orbit-1 --smoke` pending approvals.

mike-ops: Opening quota ticket today (ETA 2026-04-05). @kevin-kms please request KMS tenant. @anya-legal start DPA addendum; attach to marketplace listing.

lara-partnerships: Proposed timeline: quota approved by 4/5, DPA by 4/7 -> internal soft launch 4/9, partner notice 4/14. OK with sales/marketing?

jess-sales: internal soft launch OK; public announcement needs PR sign-off after legal confirmation. I'll loop in marketing once DPA is final.

sam-engineering: Add a rollback/fallback plan: route critical customers to eu-west1/dedicated pools if orbit perf drops. Will add canary rollout steps to runbook.

kevin-kms: KMS ticket ORBIT-KMS-4321 opened. Software keys provisioned; HSM migration tentatively 2026-04-25.

anya-legal: DPA addendum draft in ~4 hours for review.

terry-cloud-sys: Quota ticket QC-9876 submitted on partner portal; they asked for usage justification (added 120 QPS + model sizes).

lara-partnerships: Action items: mike monitor QC-9876 and escalate if needed; kevin share key ARN; anya finish DPA; sam prepare canary/fallback; jess hold public comms until PR sign-off. I'll update when launch date locked. :thumbsup:

mike-ops: Thanks, will escalate to Orbit PM if approval stalls.

deploy-bot: Reminder: smoke deploy job queued for 2026-04-09T02:00:00Z pending quota + KMS.

lara-partnerships: tagging partners in partner channel and will request integration test windows. Reopen thread if blockers appear.
